question: With rectangle shapes, neck splitting and flat-top protection, does the geometry proposer find box products (standing and lying) without naming them cylinders, and without losing cylinders?

data.development: box scenes 1101..1136 and cylinder scenes 1001..1024 (the proposer was tuned on 1101..1112 only)
data.held_out: box scenes 2101..2136 (perception_proposals.BOX_HELD_OUT_SEEDS): tray of boxes and cylinders plus lane columns, wrist views as CMB-113. Recorded once, read once, result file never overwritten; proposer configuration frozen in proposal_config_cmb120.json (sha256 in the result).

unit_and_match_rule: as proposal_acceptance_bounds.json (CMB-113): recallable product x wrist frame, strict one-to-one match at mask IoU >= 0.5
pass_rule: a check passes when the point estimate meets the bound, the scene-clustered 95 % bootstrap limit (lower end for a minimum, upper end for a maximum) meets 'limit', and the sample (n, scenes) is met; fails if the point estimate or the limit misses with the sample met; inconclusive if the sample is short. Overall PASS only if every check passes. A fail is recorded as a fail; nothing is re-run.

checks.description: share of matched boxes whose proposal carries a catalogued cylinder class (CMB-119: 0.20)
CMB-113 overall bound, cylinders in the same scenes
CMB-113 lying 0.961 on its own held-out

reported_without_bound: recall by SKU, view, tray kind
frozen CMB-113 proposer on the same frames (paired comparison)
